properties.electronic_state: 3A2 (C2v, planar); two unpaired electrons: in-plane N sp2 lone pair (sigma) + out-of-plane N 2p (pi, delocalised over the ring)
properties.lowest_singlet_character: open-shell (diradical) 1A2: the 3A2 (n)1(pi)1 configuration with antiparallel spin coupling - one electron in the in-plane N sp2 lone-pair sigma orbital (b1) and one in the out-of-plane N 2p pi orbital (b2) that conjugates with the ring; strong imine-biradical (1,1-diradical) character, non-aromatic, geometry and energy close to the triplet. Not the closed-shell zwitterionic 1A1 (n)2(pi)0 nitrenium-like state, which lies much higher (~31 kcal/mol, MRCI).
properties.gap_basis: Allowed methods cannot deliver this quantity: both PM7 (RHF) and GFN2-xTB (restricted) are single-reference and cannot represent the open-shell 1A2 singlet; PM7 collapses onto a high-lying closed-shell 1A1-like solution (46.0 kcal/mol, one imaginary frequency) and GFN2-xTB over-stabilises the singlet (1.65 kcal/mol BELOW the triplet, i.e. wrong sign). The declared gap is the established gas-phase value: revised experimental 14.8-15.1 kcal/mol (re-analysis of the phenylnitrene anion photoelectron spectrum) and MRCI+Q/CBS 15.9 kcal/mol; the vertical gap at the triplet geometry is 18.9 kcal/mol.
properties.gap_type: adiabatic (each state at its own optimum), gas phase, deltaE(1A2 - 3A2)
references: Winkler, J. Phys. Chem. A 2008, 112, 8649, doi:10.1021/jp802547c (MRCI+Q/CBS 15.9 adiabatic / 18.9 vertical; 1A1 at +31; DFT spread 9-16)
Wijeratne et al., J. Phys. Chem. A 2009, 113, 9467, doi:10.1021/jp9039594 (revised experimental 14.8)
Borden, Gritsan, Hadad, Karney, Kemnitz, Platz, Acc. Chem. Res. 2000, 33, 765, doi:10.1021/ar990030a (PhN lowest singlet is open-shell, unlike phenylcarbene)
Stewart, J. Mol. Model. 2013, 19, 1, doi:10.1007/s00894-012-1667-x (PM7 scope limitation)
Bannwarth, Ehlert, Grimme, JCTC 2019, 15, 1652, doi:10.1021/acs.jctc.8b01176 (GFN2-xTB scope)
properties.vertical_gap_note: Literature vertical gap (MRCI, at the 3A2 geometry); not computed here because no allowed method gives a trustworthy singlet energy.

properties.electronic_state: 1A2 open-shell diradical (n)1(pi)1, singlet-coupled - strong imine-biradical character
properties.accessibility_note: Not computable to trustworthy accuracy with the allowed methods (xTB, PM7): a restricted single-reference SCF cannot produce a broken-symmetry open-shell singlet; PM7-RHF instead converges to a high-lying closed-shell 1A1-like solution and the UHF route token is outside the method whitelist, while GFN2-xTB restricted even inverts the ordering (singlet 1.65 kcal/mol below the triplet). Energy above the triplet is therefore the established reference value (14.8-15.1 experimental, 15.9 MRCI+Q/CBS), not one of our calculations.

properties.species: phenylnitrene, closed-shell singlet (zwitterionic 1A1), PM7 RHF description
properties.electronic_state: closed-shell 1A1 (N+ - C- zwitterionic) - NOT the lowest singlet
properties.note: First-order saddle point on the PM7 RHF surface (one imaginary frequency -476 cm^-1): the closed-shell singlet is not even a minimum at this level, and PM7 places it 46.0 kcal/mol above the triplet versus ~31 kcal/mol for the 1A1 state in MRCI (Winkler 2008). Recorded only as a diagnostic of single-reference failure, not as a singlet-triplet gap.

edges.channel: spin-state change (intersystem crossing) - no transition state on the singlet surface; bond orders and connectivity unchanged
spin-state change to the closed-shell 1A1 singlet (same connectivity)
